name: std::chrono::year_month_day_last::year_month_day_last

declarations.code:
constexpr year_month_day_last(const std::chrono::year &y,

    const std::chrono::month_day_last &mdl) noexcept;

intro: Constructs a year_month_day_last object storing the year y and the month mdl.month(). The constructed object represents the last day of that year and month.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: A year_month_day_last can also be created by combining a std::chrono::year_month with std::chrono::last using operator/.
